create_merge_request_note.description: Add a new note to a merge request. Use this for a new resource or action; choose the corresponding update or edit tool when the resource already exists. It changes remote GitLab state and requires the necessary project or group permission; GitLab returns validation, conflict, permission, or rate-limit errors instead of silently applying an invalid request. When `project_id` or `group_id` is accepted, provide the numeric ID or complete URL-encoded path described by the schema; use required identifiers and pagination fields exactly as documented.

body.description: The content of the note or reply

merge_request_iid.description: The IID of a merge request

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project
